North calculation:
Salary + Bonus = 185,000 + 15%*185,000 = 185,000 + 27,750 = 212,750
After-tax cash = 212,750 * (1-0.30) = 212,750 * 0.70 = 148,925

Retirement match = 3%*185,000 = 5,550, capped at 6,000 => 5,550

Equity vested by month 12 = 80,000 * 1/4 with 1-year cliff = 20,000 vests at 12 months

North first-year value = 148,925 + 5,550 + 20,000 = 174,475

South calculation:
Salary + Bonus = 140,000 + 10%*140,000 = 140,000 + 14,000 = 154,000
After-tax cash = 154,000 * 0.70 = 107,800

Retirement match = 6%*140,000 = 8,400, capped at 6,000 => 6,000

Equity vested by month 12 = 160,000 * 12/48 monthly over 4 years = 160,000 * 0.25 = 40,000

South first-year value = 107,800 + 6,000 + 40,000 = 153,800

174,475 > 153,800, so North is higher.
